audience: anyone who has played a game
summary: A strong daily: Tetris, Minecraft, GTA V, Wii Sports and Mario Kart are gimmes, Terraria and The Witcher 3 are fair stretches, and misses like Super Mario Bros. (#11) and The Sims (#14) feel like near misses. Ran as a daily on 2026-10-21, so not urgent.
reasons: The casual player found 8 of 10 and only ran out of lives on the 15th guess; misses were famous games just outside the top 10.
Fortnite costs a life as an unranked answer; fair under the rules but it will catch many players.
Blitz is fine but not deep: franchise guesses (Zelda, Sonic, Mario Kart, Cyberpunk) go to a choice prompt and Fortnite, Halo and Among Us score nothing.
fixes: Drop single-word fragments made by splitting slash and colon titles: 'Deluxe' (Mario Kart 8), 'Human' (Human: Fall Flat), 'Plus' (Wii Fit), 'Blue', 'Yellow', 'Silver', 'Crystal', 'Shield', 'Pearl', 'Platinum', 'Violet', 'Ultra Sun', 'Ultra Moon', and glued aliases like 'Pokémon Red, Blue, Yellow'.

Drop junk redirect aliases: 'Tetris music', 'Controversies surrounding Grand Theft Auto V', 'Controversies surrounding GTA V', 'Controversies surrounding Minecraft', the 'Minecraft chat report(ing)' family, 'Minecraft and LGBT(Q/QIA+)', "Minecraft's cultural impact".

Remove non-games from the unranked pool: people (Ludwig Ahgren, Laura Bailey, Greg Miller, Amir Satvat, Carol Shaw, Boogie2988, Bugha, Chovy, SonicFox), esports teams (Cloud9, G2 Esports, Ninjas in Pyjamas), studios (CD Projekt Red) and TV (Arcane).
'sonic' offers Mario & Sonic and Sonic Boom titles but not #21 Sonic the Hedgehog; give #21 the 'Sonic' alias priority.
